selection: highest mean development NDCG@5; report all predeclared ablations on final holdout, never select on test
gate: primary NDCG difference user bootstrap lower bound > 0; Hit@1 and cold-click Top1 differences nonnegative; both development folds positive

assumptions.history: fixed history strictly preceding each official split
assumptions.publication_time: published_time assumed stable; inconsistent requests quarantined
assumptions.candidate_set: recorded inview candidates; conditional on a clicked request; not a causal CTR estimator

negative_control: deterministic permutation of user histories within the same snapshot, applied to personalized model without retraining
